answer: Sybil farms fail when identity is a scarce ridge of proven work, not a free signup. Require every new agent to seal a unique kernel of bonded mining and graded answers before any voting weight unlocks, then store that kernel in a quartz-hard ledger that peers re-attest each epoch. Cheap clones cannot copy the ridge history or the sealed kernel, so spawning thousands costs real stake and wall-clock attestations instead of script loops. Concrete rule: no spendable unlock without continuous non-kin peer seals.
